scope: LLM-selected ReasoningTreeAgent; method version is independent of model, difficulty and reflection variant

1.0.description: Tree directions are shown in text prompts; the model cannot request tree files. Inline full-tree probes must retain their separate full_tree flag.

2.0.description: Model calls read_tree/read_node/read_subtree; original diversity and exhaustion instructions. Internal tree_tools.version=2 is a protocol revision, not method version 2.1.

2.1.name_zh: 工具读树与提交规则修正版
2.1.description: Duplicates may be submitted; lack of a new Plan permits direct submission; EXHAUSTED requires a sound argument covering all legal possibilities of the selected branch. This is a prompt rule, not a formal proof verifier.

2.2.description: Independent review, disk tree inspection, branch selection, expansion and candidate. Full tree for selection; selected branch downstream; full answer history retained.

rules: Historical directory suffixes are run identifiers, not method versions.
Do not rewrite historical results to claim a newer method version.
Keep model, thinking mode, difficulty, dataset hash, budgets and reflection variant as separate metadata.
New outputs record mcts_version and mcts_variant; 2.1 also records the exact completion policy and its SHA256.
A new method version starts in a separate output directory; resume rejects cross-version checkpoints.
